description: Source code for hardware models simulation and timer management in Zephyr POSIX environment, including signal handling, timer scheduling, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: hwm_signal_end_handler
methods.description: Handles SIGTERM and SIGINT signals by setting a flag to end simulation.

methods.name: hwm_set_sig_handler
methods.description: Sets up signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT with SA_RESETHAND flag.

methods.name: hwm_sleep_until_next_timer
methods.description: Advances simulation time to the next timer event and checks for termination signals.

methods.name: hwm_find_next_timer
methods.description: Finds the next timer event among all scheduled timers.

methods.name: hwm_one_event
methods.description: Executes the next scheduled hardware event based on the timer.

methods.name: posix_get_hw_cycle
methods.description: Returns the current hardware cycle time, same as hwm_get_time.

methods.name: hwm_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware models and signal handlers.

methods.name: hwm_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated by hardware models.
